posts.title: How Much Does a Mini Excavator Cost? 2026 Price Guide
posts.excerpt: Mini excavator prices vary widely by size, brand and specification. We break down current price ranges, what affects cost, and how to budget for a compact digger in 2026.

body.p: Mini excavator pricing is driven by operating weight, engine emission tier, track type, cab configuration and brand. A small 0.8-ton unit costs far less than a fully equipped 3-ton machine with an enclosed cab.

As a rule of thumb, expect a usable entry-level mini excavator from a Chinese manufacturer to start in the lower five-figure USD range, with larger, cabbed, emission-compliant models climbing significantly. Port costs, shipping and attachments all add to the landed price.

Used machines can save money up front but often carry hidden wear in the undercarriage and hydraulics. New machines from Hongda include a one-year warranty, genuine spare-parts support and engines certified to EPA or EU Stage V — which also simplifies importing into many countries.
Talk to our sales team with your job size and attachment needs and we will recommend a model and configuration that fits both your application and your budget.

posts.title: How Much Does a Mini Skid Steer Weigh? Complete Guide
posts.excerpt: Weight determines transport, ground pressure and capacity. Here is what mini skid steers actually weigh and why it matters on the jobsite.

body.p: Mini skid steers generally weigh between 1,000 and 3,000 kg depending on size, drive type and cab equipment. Stand-on models are the lightest, while tracked compact loaders are the heaviest in the class.

Lighter machines are easier to trailer, gentler on turf and more maneuverable. Heavier machines bring more breakout force and stability. Always check the rated operating capacity against the weight of the materials you plan to move.
Hongda publishes full specification sheets including operating weight, transport dimensions and ground pressure so you can plan trailers and site access with confidence.

posts.title: Wheel Loader Brake Systems: Working Principles and Common Faults
posts.excerpt: Understanding how wheel loader brakes work helps you diagnose faults early and avoid expensive downtime on site.

body.p: Most modern wheel loaders use hydraulic wet-disc brakes sealed inside the axles. Because the discs run in oil, they cool well and resist dust and water — ideal for loader duty.

The most frequent issues are contaminated brake oil, worn seals causing oil bypass, and low accumulator pressure leading to a soft pedal. Regular oil sampling and scheduled axle service prevent most failures.
If your brake warning light stays on or stopping distances increase, stop the machine and check the hydraulic charge pressure before continuing work.

posts.title: Excavator Overheating Problem: Signs, Reasons and Fixes
posts.excerpt: An overheating excavator loses power and risks serious engine damage. Learn the warning signs and the most common causes we see in the field.

body.p: Overheating usually announces itself through the temperature gauge, reduced hydraulic power, or a faint burning smell from the engine bay. Ignoring it can warp heads and ruin the engine.

Clogged radiator fins, a slipping fan belt, low coolant, a stuck thermostat, and overfilled or degraded hydraulic oil are the usual culprits. In dusty sites, radiator cores can plug in a single shift.
Clean the cooling package daily in dusty conditions, check coolant levels every morning, and have the hydraulic oil tested at each service interval.

posts.title: Gradall vs Excavator: Key Differences and Which to Choose
posts.excerpt: Gradall-style telescopic excavators and conventional excavators each have strengths. Here is how to decide which suits your work.

body.p: A conventional excavator uses a boom-and-arm design that is powerful, precise and affordable. A Gradall-style machine extends a telescopic boom for flat, parallel grading along slopes and shoulders.

body.h: Which one is right for you?
body.p: For general digging, trenching and demolition, a conventional excavator offers the best combination of breakout force and value. For highway ditch grading and finishing slopes, a telescopic machine is hard to beat.
Most contractors we work with choose a conventional excavator first, then add attachments to expand its range.

posts.title: How to Import Excavator from China? A Real Case Study
posts.excerpt: Follow a real buyer from first inquiry to delivered machine — the documents, inspections, payment terms and shipping steps for importing an excavator from China.

body.p: A distributor in South America needed three mini excavators and one 8-ton digger. This is the step-by-step path they took with our team.

Step one is confirming the model, engine emission tier and attachments to match your local regulations. Step two is a proforma invoice, deposit and production. Step three is pre-shipment inspection, then sea freight, customs clearance and delivery.
The buyer saved roughly 30% versus equivalent machines from their local dealer network, while still receiving a one-year warranty and remote technical support from our factory team.

posts.title: 9 Types of Excavator Buckets You Should Know
posts.excerpt: From general-purpose to rock, trenching and cleaning buckets — choosing the right bucket transforms your excavator’s productivity.

body.p: The bucket is the excavator’s most-used tool, yet many operators run a single general bucket for every job. Matching bucket type and width to the task cuts cycle times and fuel burn.

General-purpose, grading, trenching, ditching, rock, cleaning, skeleton, tilt and 4-in-1 buckets each have a specialty. Wide buckets move more material; narrow buckets dig deeper and into tight slots.
Our sales engineers can help you build a bucket package for your typical jobs — one machine can carry a full attachment fleet.

posts.title: Essential Equipment to Start a Landscaping Business
posts.excerpt: A beginner’s guide to the machines that unlock landscaping revenue — and the compact options that keep startup costs low.

body.p: Landscaping work quickly outgrows shovels and wheelbarrows. The question is which machine to buy first.

body.h: Start with a skid steer or compact loader
body.p: A skid steer with a bucket, pallet forks and an auger covers mulch installation, soil moving, fence work and material handling. Add a mini excavator when digging and drainage work becomes regular.
Both machines trailer easily behind a pickup, which keeps mobilization simple and lets you quote jobs across a wide area.

posts.title: What Is a Backhoe? A Complete Beginner’s Guide
posts.excerpt: Backhoe loaders combine a loader and a digger in one machine. Learn how they work, what they cost and what they are best at.

body.p: A backhoe loader has a loading bucket at the front and a digging arm (the “backhoe”) at the rear. That single machine can dig a trench, then turn around and load the spoil into a truck.
Backhoes shine on utility work, small foundations, drainage and general contracting where jobs change every hour. Their road speed lets them travel between nearby sites without a lowboy.
Choose a side-shift model for working along walls and curbs, or a center-mount model for maximum digging power in open ground.

stories.name: Parts & Components
stories.short: Genuine parts and world-brand components keep you working.
stories.intro: We use proven global component brands and back every machine with genuine spare parts — so repairs are predictable and downtime stays short.

sections.p: Engines from Kubota, Yanmar, Cummins and Isuzu; pumps and valves from leading hydraulic suppliers; motors, seals and filters sourced for reliability and easy local replacement.
Order filters, bucket teeth, track parts, hoses and wear parts directly from our parts center. We ship globally and recommend a starter spare-parts kit with every machine order.

stories.name: Production & Quality
stories.short: Six-step in-house manufacturing and a strict QC system.
stories.intro: We control the process from steel plate to shipping crate. That is how we keep quality high and prices fair.

stories.name: Warranty Policy
stories.short: One-year warranty, genuine parts and clear claims.
stories.hero: Warranty Protection You Can Rely On
stories.intro: Every new Hongda machine includes a standard one-year warranty covering manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship, backed by our after-sales team.

sections.p: Structural components, hydraulic system components and the powertrain are covered against manufacturing defects for 12 months from delivery. Wear items such as bucket teeth, tracks, filters and cutting edges are excluded.

Contact your sales representative or our after-sales desk with your machine serial number and a description or video of the issue. We will diagnose by remote video, then supply replacement parts or guide local repairs under warranty.
Optional extended warranty and a prepaid parts plan are available for fleets and dealers. Ask us for a custom support agreement.

contactTopics.name: OEM Solution
contactTopics.short: Private-label and custom-configured machines for your brand.
contactTopics.intro: Build your own equipment brand without owning a factory. Hongda manufactures machines to your specification and paints them in your colors with your decals.

points.p: Choose engine brand, emission tier, cab style, bucket package, quick couplers and attachments to match your market.
We apply your logo, color scheme, decals and serial-number system on the production line — not after the fact.
Get certificates of origin, CE/EPA documentation and technical files prepared for your import and registration process.
We work with a limited number of OEM partners per market and respect your distribution agreements.

contactTopics.name: Dealer Opportunity
contactTopics.intro: We are expanding our distributor network worldwide. Dealers get factory-direct pricing, marketing support, training and priority allocation of popular models.

points.p: Tiered dealer pricing that rewards volume, with demo-machine programs for your showroom.
Early access to production slots for fast-moving models like mini excavators and skid steers.
Product photography, brochures, spare-parts kits and joint advertising funds to help you sell.
We train your technicians and sales staff — online and at our factory — and back you with remote diagnostics.

contactTopics.name: Payment & Delivery
contactTopics.short: Flexible payment terms and worldwide shipping.
contactTopics.hero: Payment & Delivery That De-Risk Your Purchase
contactTopics.intro: Clear payment stages and multiple shipping options protect both sides. Most buyers pay a deposit, inspect before shipping, then settle the balance against shipping documents.

points.p: Typical terms are 30% deposit to start production and 70% balance against the Bill of Lading. T/T, wire transfer and letters of credit are accepted.
We welcome a third-party inspection (SGS/BV) or your own agent at our factory before the balance payment.
Choose FOB Qingdao/Tianjin, CIF or DDP to your door. We handle consolidation, ro-ro or container shipping and all export documentation.
Popular models are typically produced and ready within 15–30 working days after deposit, depending on configuration.

contactTopics.name: Maintenance
contactTopics.short: Daily checks, service intervals and maintenance videos.
contactTopics.intro: Preventive maintenance keeps your machine working and protects your warranty. We make it easy with grouped service points and clear schedules.

points.p: A 5-minute walk-around: fluid levels, leaks, tracks/tires, grease points and warning lights.
Engine oil and filter changes follow the engine maker’s hours; hydraulic oil and filters follow our schedule in the operator manual.
Use genuine Hongda filters and oils to protect your warranty and component life. We stock the parts and ship worldwide.
Our service team provides step-by-step maintenance videos and live video guidance for your mechanics.

contactTopics.name: After Sales Service
contactTopics.short: Remote diagnostics, spare parts and responsive support.
contactTopics.intro: A machine purchase should come with a support team, not a goodbye. Our after-sales desk assists every customer — direct or via distributors.

points.p: Every machine includes a 12-month warranty on manufacturing defects, with a simple video-first claims process.
Send us a video or photo of the issue and our engineers will guide your mechanic through the fix in real time.
Our Jinan parts center and overseas warehouses keep fast-moving parts in stock and ship within 24 hours on most orders.
Even after the warranty period, we continue to answer technical questions and supply parts for your machine.

contactTopics.name: FAQs
contactTopics.short: Frequently asked questions about buying and owning.
contactTopics.intro: Quick answers to the questions buyers ask us most — from shipping and payment to emissions, parts and warranty.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: There is no minimum for standard machines — one unit is fine. OEM programs typically start at container quantities depending on machine size.

faqs.q: Can I visit the factory before ordering?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We host buyers in Jinan for factory tours, test drives and face-to-face meetings. We can also arrange online video factory tours.

faqs.q: Which emission standards can your machines meet?
faqs.a: Standard engines are available, and we offer EPA Tier 4 Final and EU Stage V certified engine options on most mini excavators and loaders.

faqs.q: Do you offer spare parts with the machine?
faqs.a: Yes — we recommend a starter kit of filters, belts and wear parts with every order, and we stock ongoing parts supply from our parts center.
Ocean freight from Qingdao/Tianjin to most major ports takes 20–45 days depending on destination. Production is typically 15–30 working days after deposit.

faqs.q: Can I brand the machine with my own logo?
faqs.a: Yes. We support OEM/private-label programs including custom paint, decals, logos and serial numbering. Ask our sales team for details.

contactTopics.name: Exchange & Refund
contactTopics.intro: We want you to be confident in your purchase. Read the terms below for defects, returns and exchanges on standard catalog machines.

points.p: If a new machine arrives with a manufacturing defect, contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos and the serial number. We will repair, replace parts, or arrange a solution per the warranty terms.
Within 14 days of delivery, a machine with a confirmed factory defect that cannot be repaired on site may be exchanged for an equivalent model.
Custom-configured and OEM machines are produced to your specification and therefore are not eligible for change-of-mind refunds once production begins.
Only pay through the verified corporate bank accounts on your official proforma invoice. Never send money to personal or third-party accounts — see our Security Alert page.
